title: Refill Pantry Jar Wall Built from Donated Glass Containers
description: This project turns donated glass jars into a tidy refill shelf for the community pantry so dry goods can be stored clearly, neatly, and with less disposable packaging. The raised points will cover cleaning supplies, replacement lids, printed labels, shelf brackets, and simple measuring tools so the pantry team can organize grains, beans, and spices in reusable containers instead of relying only on single-use bags. It is a small infrastructure project, but it makes refilling easier and gives donated glass a practical second life.
